findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler is now abstract and cannot be instantiated
findings.body: Changing MetricAlertDetectorHandler to inherit from StatefulDetectorHandler while leaving its body empty leaves counter_names, get_dedupe_value, get_group_key_values, and build_occurrence_and_event_data abstract. Accessing detector.detector_handler for the registered metric_alert_fire type therefore raises TypeError instead of returning the previous no-op handler. process_detectors does not catch this exception, so processing a detector of this type aborts the batch. Keep a concrete no-op implementation until the stateful methods are implemented, or implement the required methods here.

findings.title: Expected occurrence uses a different group key from the evaluation
findings.body: test_dedupe builds its expected occurrence with group key 'val1', but calls evaluate_group_key_value with 'group_key'. The new occurrence builder includes the group key in the fingerprint, so the actual occurrence has fingerprint '<detector id>:group_key' while the expected occurrence has '<detector id>:val1'. The result equality assertion consequently fails. Build the expected occurrence using the same group key passed to the evaluation.
